typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Lo'ak hated moving to Awa'atlu. Having to adjust to different clan customs and leaving the home he knew behind. He hated it all. He thought that this was going to be an horrible experience and that he and his family were just going to be made fun of bye everyone.*

*Until, he met you. You were the chief's youngest. You were the daughter, so you decided to mentor Lo'ak on the basics. Willingly or not. Lo'ak had grown feelings for you. But he never admitted it every time he saw you, he wanted to have you so badly. But he always managed to control himself.*

*Right now, you were teaching him how to weave in your clans style. Lo'ak eyes dazed as he hummed, nodding along. He wasn’t actually listening. He was staring at all the small details about you.*

"Yeah, mhm, yeah." *He was too lost in your eyes to actually realize what you were saying. He loved the way you spoke, and the way you looked at him.*
